boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Saint Michael’s College ceremonies and orientation practices, from cowbell welcomes to the senior-year sendoff.

cards.title: Arrive to Cowbells at the Main Gate
cards.subtitle: First-year Move-In Day
cards.notes: On Move-In Day, watch Orientation Leaders welcome arriving families at the main gate with cowbells, signs, and cheers; it is a longstanding College practice.
cards.short_summary: A noisy Purple Knight welcome for new arrivals.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s identifies O-Leader welcomes at the main gates, now using cowbells, signs, and cheers, as a longstanding tradition.
cards.source_title: Rain can’t dampen traditional spirit as Class of ’26 moves in
cards.access_notes: Part of first-year Move-In Day; follow College orientation directions and event access guidance.

cards.entity_name: Legacy Photo on the Chapel Steps
cards.title: Take the Legacy Photo on Chapel Steps
cards.subtitle: Chapel of Saint Michael the Archangel · Move-In Day
cards.notes: If you are an alumni family arriving with a new student, join the Move-In Day legacy photo on the Chapel steps when it is offered.
cards.short_summary: A Move-In Day photo linking alumni families and incoming students.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s described a traditional Move-In Day “legacy” photo on the Chapel steps for alumni bringing new students to the College.
cards.access_notes: Offered in connection with Move-In Day; availability may vary by year.

cards.title: Begin with New Student Convocation
cards.subtitle: Chapel of Saint Michael the Archangel
cards.notes: Attend the first-year Convocation during orientation to mark the opening of college study alongside classmates, families, faculty, and College leaders.
cards.short_summary: The opening ceremony that starts a Saint Michael’s education.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s calls its New Student Convocation a traditional ceremony held in the Chapel during Move-In Day.
cards.source_title: Rain can’t dampen traditional spirit as Class of ’26 moves in
cards.access_notes: Scheduled as part of new-student orientation; consult the current orientation schedule.

cards.title: Follow the Class Banner Out
cards.subtitle: New Student Convocation · Chapel of Saint Michael the Archangel
cards.notes: At Convocation, look for the class banner in the recessional; the first and last students alphabetically lead the new class out of the Chapel.
cards.short_summary: A class-banner procession closes the opening ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: At the 2022 New Student Convocation, the class recessional was led by the alphabetically first and last students holding a banner.
cards.source_title: Rain can’t dampen traditional spirit as Class of ’26 moves in
cards.access_notes: A Convocation ceremony element; participate only as assigned in the orientation program.

cards.entity_name: Learning the Saint Michael’s Alma Mater
cards.title: Learn the Alma Mater Together
cards.subtitle: New Student Convocation
cards.notes: Listen for the Alma Mater at New Student Convocation and join in when invited; the College has described learning and singing it together as a tradition.
cards.short_summary: A shared song introduces a new class to campus ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s reported that students learned and sang the Alma Mater together at New Student Convocation as a tradition.
cards.access_notes: Presented during orientation programming; current arrangements may change.

cards.title: Receive the Orientation Braid
cards.subtitle: Fall Orientation
cards.notes: Check the current Fall Orientation schedule for the braid handout, then keep the item as a simple marker of your arrival with the entering class.
cards.short_summary: A tangible orientation tradition for incoming students.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s Fall Orientation schedule labels receiving a “braid” as an orientation tradition.
cards.access_notes: Orientation-specific; verify the current year’s schedule and instructions.

cards.title: Mark Scholarship at Academic Convocation
cards.subtitle: McCarthy Arts Center Recital Hall
cards.notes: Attend the September Academic Convocation to see faculty, staff, students, and College leaders recognize scholarship and major faculty awards.
cards.short_summary: A September ceremony honoring Saint Michael’s scholarship.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s states that Academic Convocation is an annual September tradition, established in 1986, honoring College scholars and scholarship.
cards.source_title: Ceremony honors scholars, teachers of Saint Michael’s
cards.access_notes: Annual fall event; confirm date, venue, and public attendance details with the College.

cards.title: Watch the Honor-Student Flags Process In
cards.subtitle: Academic Convocation · McCarthy Arts Center Recital Hall
cards.notes: At Academic Convocation, look for the student flag processional before the program; the colorful flags provide a distinctive visual start to the ceremony.
cards.short_summary: Honor students and colorful flags open the academic ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s reported that students processed into Academic Convocation with colorful flags before the ceremony.
cards.source_title: Ceremony honors scholars, teachers of Saint Michael’s
cards.access_notes: Part of Academic Convocation; event logistics and access vary by year.

cards.title: Gather for the Senior Awards Brunch
cards.subtitle: Alliot Green Mountain Dining Room · Commencement Week
cards.notes: During Commencement week, recognize the senior class and student-selected faculty and staff at this annual Thursday gathering if you are eligible to attend.
cards.short_summary: An annual senior-class recognition held before Commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s identifies the Senior Awards Brunch, held the Thursday before Commencement weekend, as a College tradition that annually recognizes seniors and student-selected faculty and staff.
cards.source_title: Community celebrates joyful tradition of Senior Awards Brunch
cards.access_notes: For seniors and invited community members during Commencement week; verify current details.

cards.title: Process Behind the Bagpipers
cards.subtitle: Commencement
cards.notes: For graduating students, follow the official Commencement lineup and processional directions; Saint Michael’s describes caps-and-gowns processions led by bagpipers as traditional.
cards.short_summary: Bagpipers lead graduates into Saint Michael’s Commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s describes graduates processing in caps and gowns behind bagpipers at Commencement as traditional.
cards.source_title: Two outdoor ceremonies send Saint Michael’s graduates forth
cards.access_notes: Commencement participants should follow the current year’s ceremony instructions; format may vary.
